verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows an 'external access token' used for a few narrow services (Deployments API, dSYM/ProGuard/JS uploads) and CSV export features, with no documentation of a general REST API to list, query, or update issues or fetch raw events. Probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs and llms.txt both returned 404, and no scoped-token API reference for issue management is cited.
